_comment: Drop this file at .claude/rax/config.json to customize. Delete the `_comment` keys — they're here for documentation only. Any key you omit falls back to the skill default.

weights._comment: Category weights. Must sum to 100 (±0.5 tolerance). Defaults shown here.

ignore._comment: Glob patterns relative to repo root. Matched files are skipped entirely. The skill already ignores node_modules, build outputs, and generated files — these are *additional* exclusions.

focus._comment: If set, ONLY files matching at least one pattern are audited. Use for focused audits of a module or feature. Leave empty array to audit everything in scope.

rules._comment: Rule-level overrides. Use `disable` to skip a subcriterion (e.g. if it's categorically inapplicable and you don't want `n/a` noise). Use `severity.floor` to force a minimum severity for a subcriterion — useful to tighten security standards.

scope._comment: Override detected source root. Most projects don't need this.

reporting._comment: Control report output. `language` accepts any language code; `en` is default. `save_report` toggles writing to .claude/rax/reports/. `chat_summary` controls whether Claude prints the full report to chat or a summary with a link.

baseline._comment: Baseline policy. `auto_save` writes a baseline on full-mode runs with a clean tree without asking. `per_branch` keeps separate baselines per branch (recommended).
